title: Harbison Labor-Only Protection: Charging the Claim Service Fee for a Service Call
content:
**What this covers.** The claim service fee charged on a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract — the labor-only tiers of Harbison Protection Contracts — for the service call on which a claim against that contract was decided on the date of handling. One fee is charged per service call, and none is charged on a service call whose claims against the contract are all denied.

**Basis.** The claim service fee for a service call is fixed only after every claim filed on that call against the contract carries its original decision.

Put another way, while any claim filed on the call against the contract still has no original decision on its record, the fee for that call is not yet fixed.

**Which claim the charge names.** The fee charge names the first approved claim of the service call, which is the claim on that call whose approving original decision was posted earliest, even where a later decision on the same call is the one that lets the fee be fixed.

**What the posting does.** One claim service fee charge is posted on the contract's billing history, dated the day it is posted, naming one claim of the service call and the service call it is charged for, and the amount the holder owes on the contract rises by that fee. The holder sees the fee and the new balance owed right away.

### Tool: `charge_claim_service_fee_b62a9756`

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | reference number of the protection contract the fee is charged on, from the protection contract lookup | id |
| `claim_id` | reference number of the claim named on the fee — the claim-file entry's reference number of a claim on that service call, from the contract's claim history | id |
| `ticket_id` | reference number of the service call the fee is charged for, from the claim history or the service call lookup | id |
| `fee_amount` | the fee charged | US dollars, 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded to the cent half up |

**Return.** A receipt listing `warranty_billing_id` (reference number of the fee charge just posted), `contract_id`, `claim_id`, `ticket_id`, `line_type` (always `claim_service_fee`), `fee_amount` (US dollars, 2 decimals), `posted_date` (today) and `contract_balance` (the amount now owed on the contract, US dollars, 2 decimals, signed). The presence of `warranty_billing_id` means the fee is on the contract.
